canDoYue: 你識用平常嘅字講鑽石證書：切工、顏色、淨度、一克拉，腰上有實驗室報告編號，同埋點解兩粒相似嘅石價錢唔同。
canDoEn: Explain a diamond certificate in plain words: cut, colour, clarity, one carat, a lab report number on the girdle, and why two similar stones have different prices.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Can you explain this diamond certificate in plain words, please?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以用簡單嘅話解釋呢張鑽石證書？
dialogue.say: Can you explain this diamond certificate in plain words, please?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Sure. The cut, colour, and clarity are all very good.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。切工、顏色同淨度都好好。
dialogue.say: Sure. The cut, colour, and clarity are all very good.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: What about the carat, and the number on the girdle?
dialogue.glossYue: 克拉點計？腰上嗰個號碼呢？
dialogue.say: What about the carat, and the number on the girdle?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: It's one carat. The lab report number is engraved on the girdle.
dialogue.glossYue: 一克拉。實驗室報告編號刻喺腰上。
dialogue.say: It's one carat. The lab report number is engraved on the girdle.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Why is this stone more expensive than the other one?
dialogue.say: Why is this stone more expensive than the other one?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: This one has a better cut. The other has a small mark.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢粒切工更好。另一粒有個小痕跡。
dialogue.say: This one has a better cut. The other has a small mark.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: So the price is higher because the cut is cleaner?
dialogue.glossYue: 所以價錢高啲，係因為切工乾淨啲？
dialogue.say: So the price is higher because the cut is cleaner?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. The report is from a lab. It is not a brand name.
dialogue.glossYue: 係。報告嚟自一間實驗室。佢唔係品牌名。
dialogue.say: Yes. The report is from a lab. It is not a brand name.

roleplay.intro: 你同 Ida 傾呢件事。等對方講完先答。
